title: Jimmy Lucky's band in Grand Rapids with Bernie Peacock and Wilbur Ware
summary: In Grand Rapids he played with alto man Bernie Peacock and a kid drummer, Wilbur Ware.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I was with Jimmy Lucky in Grand Rapids and he was a trumpet player out of Chicago and he came up there and there was a guy named Maurice Palmer and we had a little band. And Bernie Peacock, who was a friend of mine, a very famous alto player, later on. And a little drummer was around there and he was playin' drums and his name was Wilbur Ware. Yeah, that's where I met him. He was playin' drums, just a kid. And I saw him in New York several times and I says, "You know I remember you," and so we laughed about that. But Bernie Peacock became quite prominent. He was with Lucky Millender and different bands. A very fine alto player.
